author: Legoche
body:
Hello. I have recently been wondering how much players who supply chests of iron armour and defend the monument need a way of getting xp. The amount of work those guys (and girls) put in deserves xp. I was thinking about maybe at the end of a game a way to vote a player who was helpful? Trouble is, it could be abused. Any more ideas on how to implement this?

Thanks :)

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
It's voluntary, they're not forced to create supply chests. If they want to earn xp, just vote daily.
Besides, the match would just be players crafting armour, it would slow the game down, and that just isn't useful to anyone.

replies.body:
I hafta disagree on that. Sure in theory its a great idea but in reality its pretty dumb. All youll get is kiss-ups and tryhards in the community and it would be so annoying and kinda ruin gameplay (in terms of a lot of xp)


Also, just because you done something right, you dont have to be rewarded.

I feel like people shouldn't be rewarded for like every helpful thing they do. Doing something right should be voulntary, not because you want something off of your own personal gain or benefit :/
